For sale

Small one-story house in the village of Dolna Lipnitsa

Near Pavlikeni

Rural property with large garden and outbuilding near Pavlikeni

We offer for sale a single-storey house with a spacious garden in the village of Dolna Lipnitsa, a well-developed settlement located 18 km from Pavlikeni and 42 km from Veliko Tarnovo. The property is suitable for buyers seeking a peaceful countryside setting, a holiday retreat or a renovation project with long-term potential.

The house has a built-up area of 40 sq.m and occupies an easily accessible plot with a desirable south-facing aspect. The building requires complete renovation, providing an opportunity to redesign and modernise it according to the new owner's preferences.

The plot extends over 1,260 sq.m and offers ample space for landscaping, a vegetable or fruit garden, or additional outdoor leisure areas. A substantial stone-built outbuilding is also located within the property and could be used for storage, a workshop, farming activities or adapted for other purposes, subject to the owner's plans.

Thanks to its favourable orientation and the proximity of a transformer station approximately 300 metres away, the property may also offer potential for a photovoltaic project, subject to the necessary technical assessments and approvals.

Dolna Lipnitsa is a large and well-established village with shops, cafés, a kindergarten, school, petrol station, community centre, library, cultural activities and regular public transport. The village is known for its rich history and one of the oldest churches in Northern Bulgaria. The surrounding area provides excellent conditions for rural tourism, organic farming and year-round living.

This property is an excellent opportunity for buyers looking for an affordable rural home with a large plot, renovation potential and a peaceful location close to both Pavlikeni and Veliko Tarnovo.
